prompt: Who was the last Miss World America to place in the Top 11 at Miss World? Hint: She has pursued a modeling career.
answer: Audra Mari of North Dakota was the last Miss World America to place in the Top 11 at Miss World. She won Miss World America 2016, placed in the Top 11 at Miss World 2016, and later pursued a modeling career.
